messages:
Anna (Docs): heads up — I'm about to start the big 'reference -> core' docs move. I'm splitting into 4 PRs to avoid a huge diff. PRs: #8423 (redirects), #8424 (move v1), #8425 (move v2), #8426 (cross-link fixes + anchors)
Sam (Eng): thanks. timeline? any CI/docs preview flakiness risk?
Anna (Docs): plan: open #8423 first — tiny redirects file change (regex). Once that merges, we merge move PRs in order: #8424 then #8425. Then #8426 to sweep anchors and broken links. Each PR will include a docs preview link. I'll add reviewers on each.
Jules (Platform): make sure preview env has redirects applied so staging links don't 404. The preview runner uses the branch config — if we merge redirects later, previews fail. So we need #8423 preview live before others. :+1:
Priya (Docs): I'll review #8423 today. ping me when it's up. Also please add a smoke test for anchors — I hit broken anchors in the last refactor.
Anna (Docs): good point — adding a small script for anchor checks. Example I plan to run in CI:
```
# ./scripts/check-anchors.sh ./site/_build
python3 -m pip install linkchecker
linkchecker --no-warnings output/site
```
Sam (Eng): CI note: bundler job times out for giant move diffs. recommend squashing file moves into multiple commits per PR, but keep each PR <200 files. Also add `DOCS_PREVIEW=true` to the CI matrix so previews are built with the redirect PR enabled.
Anna (Docs): PR sizes: #8424 (~120 files), #8425 (~95 files). I'll add a docs-only label and request reviewers @Priya and @Sam for sequencing approval. Can we target merging #8423 tomorrow morning (UTC) and do the moves after lunch?
Jules (Platform): tomorrow morning works for operations. I'll reserve a short maintenance window 10:00–11:30 UTC for merging if needed and will watch the preview deploys.
CI Bot: build started for PR #8423 — docs-preview/preview-8423 (job 1127)
CI Bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-8423--docs.redwood.dev
Priya (Docs): preview looks good, redirects appear to be applied. I spot one small regex overshoot: `/reference/(.*)` should exclude `/reference/static/`. I'll open a tiny amend on the PR.
Anna (Docs): thanks — I'll pick that up now.
Anna (Docs): quick Q: cross-page anchors — when we move files the anchor IDs sometimes change (heading normalization). #8426 will include a mapping file to rewrite links. Are we okay to run the mapping script as a final commit in that PR rather than doing manual fixes?
Sam (Eng): mapping script is fine as long as we keep a changelog of rewritten links. Also include a rollback plan: if #8426 causes regressions, how fast can we revert? Keeping PRs separate helps revert a single PR.
Priya (Docs): agree on changelog. Also request adding anchor-level redirects where possible (HTML meta refresh or small JS).
Anna (Docs): site generator supports lightweight anchor redirects via injected fragments for top-level changed headers, but we'll rely on link rewrites for bulk.
Marcus (CI): FYI — the link-check job is scheduled to run after every merge. It's heavy; consider running it only on the final sweep PR (#8426) and spot-check on the moves.
Anna (Docs): noted — I'll mark link-check as conditional. Final ask: reviewers, please don't merge move PRs until #8423 is merged and its preview is green — otherwise previews will 404 during review. I'll post a final merge checklist in each PR.
Sam (Eng): will do. I'll be on standby during the 10:00–11:30 UTC window.
Priya (Docs): LGTM for sequencing. Ping when #8423 is green.
Anna (Docs): thanks everyone. I'll start the amend for #8423 and update PR descriptions with merge order. :rocket:
